content.text: {"pagination":{"count":10,"page":1,"next_page":2,"total_count":1000,"total_pages":100},"records":[{"platform":"desktop","title":"Elementor","url":"https://elementor.com","uuid":"86351665-7483-48d1-9be4-5fe456093686","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/elementor.com/86351665-7483-48d1-9be4-5fe456093686/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark monochrome, premium SaaS landing-page aesthetic built almost entirely on black, white, and soft off-white. The visual identity feels high-contrast and editorial, with a press-like seriousness where bold typography carries the design instead of color. The hero uses a full-bleed moody lifestyle photograph with large, tightly set white headline text layered over the image, creating a dramatic, poster-like opening. Type is heavy, compressed, and confident, with oversized weight-900 display styling and compact spacing that gives the layout a stamped, ink-on-paper feel. The top navigation is clean and restrained, set in a rounded white bar with minimal black text links and a single strong black call-to-action button. Surfaces alternate between pure black and bright white or soft foggy white, producing a checkerboard rhythm across the page. Cards are simple and geometric with generous padding, rounded corners, and no visible shadows, relying on surface inversion rather than elevation for hierarchy. Buttons are similarly minimal, with black-filled primary actions and white secondary actions, both sharply defined and highly legible. Supporting text appears in muted gray, while icons and dividers stay thin and understated. Overall, the look is polished, modern, and highly structured — a minimalist enterprise-SaaS style with an editorial edge and a strong sense of contrast, space, and typographic authority."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Ui","url":"https://ui.shadcn.com","uuid":"c14c0a94-1037-449e-bf5b-4cb972656ac7","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/ui.shadcn.com/c14c0a94-1037-449e-bf5b-4cb972656ac7/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark monochrome design system with a clean, architectural blueprint feel. The interface sits on a bright white canvas with very subtle gray borders and minimal shadow, creating a crisp, highly controlled sense of order. Typography is the main visual voice: large, confident black headings paired with compact, precise body text and tight letter spacing, giving the whole layout a technical, editorial seriousness. The composition is centered and spacious at the top, then transitions into a dense grid of neatly aligned component cards below, which makes the page feel like a curated showcase of UI primitives rather than a marketing site. Surfaces are flat and restrained, with soft rounded cards, slightly sharper input fields, and pill-shaped buttons and badges that add a gentle contrast to the otherwise geometric system. The monochromatic palette dominates, with black used for primary actions and emphasis, light gray for separators and secondary states, and only tiny semantic accents for status cues. Icons are simple, monochrome, and functional, reinforcing the utilitarian, developer-tool aesthetic. Overall it feels polished, exacting, and quietly premium, with a disciplined balance between structure and softness."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Krea","url":"https://krea.ai","uuid":"3a63b3fa-dc79-4dc3-935e-3f8f4ab447a7","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/krea.ai/3a63b3fa-dc79-4dc3-935e-3f8f4ab447a7/preview_0.jpg","description":"A moody, high-contrast dark landing page with a restrained terminal-like luxury. The entire interface is built around near-black surfaces, luminous white typography, and very subtle gray separations, creating a crisp midnight command-center feel. The visual hierarchy is clean and centered, with a classic top navigation bar, generous breathing room, and a large hero composition that dominates the screen. Typography is modern, geometric, and confident, with a large display headline in tight spacing and smaller supporting text in soft gray for a precise, editorial tone.\n\nThe page combines atmospheric photography with product mockups: a dark, cinematic background scene anchors the hero, while the central monitor screenshot adds realism and product clarity. Buttons are minimal and polished, using rounded pill and rounded-rectangle forms with white and charcoal fills, giving the interface a calm, premium SaaS feel rather than a flashy startup aesthetic. Borders, shadows, and gradients are extremely subtle, used only to separate layers and add depth. Overall the design feels sleek, focused, and quietly futuristic, with a strong monochrome palette, balanced spacing, and a refined, high-end software brand presence."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"mono","url":"https://mono.frm.fm/en","uuid":"4b3c372c-aff6-4608-bafb-1dde853c4805","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/mono.frm.fm/4b3c372c-aff6-4608-bafb-1dde853c4805/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark, editorial design system with an architectural grid and a highly controlled black-on-white palette. The overall feel is minimal, precise, and gallery-like, combining the discipline of technical drawing with the restraint of a modern art catalog. Heavy use of thin 1px rules, rigid column divisions, and boxed navigation creates a strong modular structure, while large areas of clean white space keep the composition airy and deliberate. Typography is the dominant expressive element: condensed uppercase labels, small tracked navigation, and larger refined headings create hierarchy through weight, spacing, and placement rather than color. The layout feels full-bleed and full-screen, with content arranged in asymmetrical blocks that snap to the underlying grid. Imagery is presented like curated product sculpture—tight, dramatic hardware shots and monochrome graphic forms framed within sharp-edged containers. Buttons and labels are ghosted and outlined, with a flat planar quality and no softness, shadows, or rounded corners. The result is an understated but striking design language that feels conceptual, premium, and deeply typographic, with a strong sense of precision and spatial order."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Bibliothèque","url":"https://bibliothequedesign.com","uuid":"aab168d5-0658-459f-a7e5-23982b58a876","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/bibliothequedesign.com/aab168d5-0658-459f-a7e5-23982b58a876/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark, monochrome editorial design with an almost gallery-like sense of restraint. The screen is dominated by a pure black canvas, creating a dramatic amount of negative space and an immediate feeling of focus and authority. Typography, where present, is minimal and understated, with a crisp white mark in the corner acting like a quiet signature rather than a full navigation system. The visual hierarchy is intentionally sparse, letting a single central image carry the page: a small, framed photograph floating in the darkness, presented with no visible chrome, no decorative treatment, and no competing interface noise. The overall composition feels full-bleed and immersive, yet disciplined, with a strong emphasis on contrast, silence, and editorial framing. The mood is refined, severe, and contemporary, closer to an art-book spread or minimalist design archive than a conventional digital interface. Flat surfaces, sharp edges, and the absence of color accents reinforce the austere black-and-white language, while the centered image placement gives the layout a calm, curated rhythm."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"SST","url":"https://sst.dev","uuid":"7b6c53c7-7145-476e-aed8-f2367eef3adb","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/sst.dev/7b6c53c7-7145-476e-aed8-f2367eef3adb/preview_0.jpg","description":"A clean, airy developer-tool landing page with a minimalist editorial feel. The whole interface sits on a bright white canvas with very soft gray dividers, faint shadows, and lots of breathing room, giving it the look of a carefully typeset technical document rather than a flashy marketing site. Typography does most of the work: a large, bold monospaced hero headline anchors the right side, while the rest of the copy uses a compact sans serif with restrained weight and subtle gray-violet tones. The visual balance is split between a code editor card on the left and the messaging column on the right, creating a calm, centered composition with strong hierarchy and generous spacing. The code block is the main visual motif, presented in a neat rounded card with light elevation and multicolor syntax highlighting in muted rose, violet, blue, indigo, and teal. Navigation and utility controls are tiny, crisp, and understated, using pill-like buttons, thin borders, and low-contrast text. Overall, the style feels precise, modern, and technical, with a polished Scandinavian-like restraint and a blueprint-inspired clarity."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Guglieri","url":"https://guglieri.com","uuid":"faa6336c-8e7c-4817-9285-ceb7204a2d32","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/guglieri.com/faa6336c-8e7c-4817-9285-ceb7204a2d32/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark, monochrome portfolio-style interface with a deep black canvas, crisp white typography, and a very editorial, high-contrast mood. The visual language feels razor sharp and minimal, with large bold headlines dominating the hero area and smaller, understated navigation and metadata set in thin, low-noise text. Spacing is generous and airy, creating a calm but intense presentation that lets each section breathe. The layout is full-bleed and centered around strong typographic blocks, with subtle horizontal rules and compact text clusters for hierarchy. The imagery is the main visual signature: polished 3D cursor and hand icons with glossy highlights, soft reflections, and chunky outlined forms that pop against the dark background. Supporting screenshots use desaturated grayscale photography as atmospheric backdrop material, with content layered cleanly on top in small cards and text overlays. Buttons and interactive elements are minimal, pill-shaped or ghost-like, keeping the interface lightweight and functional. Overall it feels like a refined design studio or creative director portfolio with a premium, terminal-dark aesthetic, precise spacing, and a restrained, highly intentional visual system."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Superlative","url":"https://playsuperlative.com","uuid":"4ee42a45-82e7-4a4b-8cc3-86c6b77bbca4","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/playsuperlative.com/4ee42a45-82e7-4a4b-8cc3-86c6b77bbca4/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark, precision-driven dark interface with a cinematic product-photography hero. The whole screen feels like a high-end electronic instrument or design-studio landing presentation: matte black and deep charcoal surfaces, thin white typography, and sparse orange indicator lights that read as functional rather than decorative. The layout is full-bleed and immersive, with oversized angled product imagery dominating the composition and text layered directly over it. Headings are tall, condensed, and uppercase, giving the design an engineered, industrial tone. Navigation and metadata are minimal, tucked into corners and edges with plenty of negative space. Buttons and labels are restrained, using ghost outlines, fine borders, and compact proportions. The overall mood is technical, premium, and disciplined, with a flat, high-contrast finish and very little visual noise."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Phantom Studios","url":"https://www.phantom.land","uuid":"57173e45-09c8-4278-9024-a634e97bacda","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/www.phantom.land/57173e45-09c8-4278-9024-a634e97bacda/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark, ultra-minimal dark studio landing aesthetic with a pure black full-bleed background and almost no ornament. The composition is extremely sparse and centered, giving the screen a quiet, cinematic emptiness with strong negative space. Typography is the main visual event: small crisp white sans-serif text sits in the middle with a restrained, refined presence, while the overall hierarchy feels subtle and tightly controlled. A thin neon green line along the bottom edge provides the only vivid accent, introducing a precise technical shimmer against the monochrome field. The design feels flat and disciplined, with no visible shadows, gradients, or layered surfaces—just clean type, hairline geometry, and a highly focused creative-agency mood that reads as modern, high-end, and digitally exact."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Beau","url":"https://beau.to","uuid":"522a3200-2712-4008-9d2f-02b584c2eaea","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/beau.to/522a3200-2712-4008-9d2f-02b584c2eaea/preview_0.jpg","description":"A crisp, minimalist SaaS landing page with a strong monochrome editorial feel. The layout is airy and highly structured, using wide white space, centered hero messaging, and a clear vertical rhythm that makes the page feel precise and intentional. Typography is the main visual driver: large bold black headlines, lighter gray supporting copy, and compact navigation text create a sharp hierarchy with a modern, geometric tone. The interface relies on simple rectangular cards with soft 6px rounding, subtle borders, and restrained shadowing, giving the content a lightweight, refined quality. Most surfaces are pure white or deep black, producing a high-contrast, almost print-like aesthetic. Product screenshots are framed as clean, contained modules, often paired with dark companion panels that amplify contrast and focus. The occasional electric orange-red-purple gradient adds a vivid, energetic accent, appearing like a spotlight or backdrop rather than a dominant theme. Buttons are compact, pill-shaped, and mostly black-filled with white text, reinforcing the polished, utility-first character. Overall, the design feels modern, efficient, and confidently minimal, with just enough color flare to keep the composition lively."}]}
